titles_read.author: Maitland and Krone (compilers/publishers)
titles_read.publisher_seen: Maitland and Krone, Publishers, Hobart; F. W. Niven and Co., Printers, Melbourne and Ballarat, Victoria (vol II title page dated 1900; vol I title page visible lacks a date in the photo)
titles_read.first_edition: Maitland and Krone, Hobart, 1900 (issued 1899-1900 in parts), 2 vols, folio, F. W. Niven printers, half leather with cloth boards. Facsimile reprints (leather, 1988 numbered edition of 500 per Treloar listing) also exist.

first_value_sold.note: The Cyclopedia of Tasmania (Illustrated), original; only price shown in the list, condition unknown
Box of vintage books incl Cyclopedia of Tas Vol 2 only; mixed lot, indicative only
Box of assorted books incl The Cyclopedia of Tasmania; mixed lot, weak evidence
2 vol LEATHERBOUND FACSIMILE, not an original; reference only
Vol I and II FACSIMILE; reference only

first_value_asking.note: 1988 numbered FACSIMILE edition of 500 asking, per search summary; not an original

titles_read.chance_first: Likely (original period set; either the 1899 or 1900 issue is an original)
titles_read.reason: Photos show an ORIGINAL not a facsimile: letterpress title pages with a halftone-era fine paper that is foxed and browned at the edges, tipped-in halftone portraits and views printed on the text paper, genuinely worn and rubbed black pebble-grain cloth with leather corners and a cracked, flaking gilt-banded leather spine with the mismatched wear between volumes, and hand inscriptions inside the front boards ('To Dad, love from ...'). The two Gowans facsimiles that sold for $110 were described as leatherbound facsimile copies; this set is half cloth with leather corners, and nothing in the images carries a reprint notice. It is two volumes with the right title pages.
titles_read.check_at_viewing: At viewing: check for any 'facsimile', 'reprint' or 1988 numbering notice on the verso; look for a limited-edition numbering page; check vol I date; confirm all plates are present and the spines hold (vol I spine is badly rubbed). Count plates against the index; condition and completeness drive value.

lots.lot_verdict: Original 1900 Maitland and Krone set in worn condition: realistic hammer about $90 to $130 (ABA 2021 $130 hammer, Gowans comparable single vol in a box $90); suggest a ceiling of about $120 hammer, and note the facsimiles that made $110 are not the same thing. Treat the set as the original but verify no reprint statement at viewing.
